create_BpfKProbe_entry_probe: create a BpfKProbe instance to trace a kernel symbol entry point on a specific CPU
create_BpfKProbe_exit_probe: create a BpfKProbe instance with exit_probe=True to trace a kernel symbol return point
start_BpfKProbe: start a BpfKProbe to register the kprobe event and attach the BPF program to it
close_BpfKProbe: close a BpfKProbe to detach the BPF program and unregister the kprobe event
use_probe_decorator: use the probe decorator to register a BPF function as a kprobe on a kernel symbol
